content: {"episode_id":"ep-05043","cpt":"93229","denial_carc":"CO-197","necessity_paragraph":"CPT 93229 mobile cardiac telemetry was ordered for a patient with recurrent episodes of palpitations, lightheadedness, and intermittent syncope suggestive of symptomatic atrial fibrillation (I48.91) and sick sinus syndrome (I49.5). Given the documented history of unexplained cardiac arrhythmias (I49.9) and the need to correlate these symptoms with rhythm disturbances, continuous electrocardiographic monitoring during daily activities was clinically indicated. The clinical indication note supporting this order accompanies this appeal, and we request reconsideration of the CO-197 denial on the basis of medical necessity."}
